mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0) indicate aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-inflation/high-rate periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1400 thousand units (HOUST > 1400) signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-housing-start periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below 100 units (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low-industrial-production periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) consistently reflects strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising-retail-sales periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.0) signals a tight labor market and economic strength, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong-employment-low-unemployment periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 295), higher interest rates and inflation expectations reduce equity attractiveness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
